text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Parliament speaker Ahmad al-Saadoun sends request by MP Jassem al-Kharafi to Constitutional Court. Kharafi is challenging Saddoun's October election as speaker.
- Some 120 commercial fraud cases recorded in November, Trade Ministry official says.
- Kuwait National Bank's (NBK) 1996 profit could exceed 70 million dinars ($234 million). NBK is the country's largest commercial bank.
- Kuwait says its human rights record is clean.
- An earthquake measuring 5.1 on the Richter scale hit Kuwait on Saturday.
- Foreign Minister Sheikh Sabah al-Ahmad al-Sabah met with the editors of local newspapers.

- Ministers tell parliament that new restrictions have been imposed in the conservative Gulf Arab state to make musical concerts and fashion shows in "harmony with traditions, customs and Islamic teachings".
